dense_parent.note: Frozen Task 3.3 winner. Identity/metrics are loaded live from results/phase3_3/qwen3_embedding.json at run time (never hardcoded/recomputed here) and this stored copy is only a plan-time cross-check.

sparse_parent.note: Frozen Task 3.4 baseline. Identity/metrics are loaded live from results/phase_3_4_bm25_fts_baseline.json at run time (never hardcoded/recomputed here) and this stored copy is only a plan-time cross-check.

parent_stream_reuse_policy: Neither parent's full top-50 ranked chunk list was persisted with self-verifying provenance in a form suitable for direct reuse (Task 3.3 never wrote per-query ranked lists to disk at all; Task 3.4's git-ignored query_diagnostics.jsonl predates this task and carries no embedded identity tag). Task 3.5 therefore reruns RETRIEVAL ONLY for both parents against their already-frozen, unmodified artifacts (the dense Qwen LanceDB index and the sparse LanceDB FTS index) - no embeddings are recomputed, no index is rebuilt, no FTS index is rebuilt. Every rerun per-question hit10/rank10/rr10/ndcg10/hit50/rank50 is verified to reproduce the frozen Task 3.3/3.4 per_question values exactly before fusion proceeds.

fusion.formula: RRF(d) = [1/(rrf_k+dense_rank(d)) if d in dense candidates else 0] + [1/(rrf_k+sparse_rank(d)) if d in sparse candidates else 0]; ranks are 1-based; ranks only, no raw dense-distance or sparse-_score normalization/mixing.
tie_break: 3. lower dense_rank (missing dense rank treated as infinity)
4. lower sparse_rank (missing sparse rank treated as infinity)

metric_definitions: doc_recall@10 / doc_recall@50 / doc_mrr / doc_ndcg@10 via src.eval.baseline_metrics-equivalent granularity-agnostic Task 2.6 functions (first_hit_rank/hit_at_k/reciprocal_rank/ndcg_at_k) plus Task 3.1's document_relevances_at_k - identical semantics to Tasks 3.1-3.4, unmodified.
selection_rule: PROJECT_EXECUTION.md Task 3.5 Stage 9, implemented in src.eval.phase3_hybrid.select_hybrid_configuration: Gate 1 (absolute) - hybrid is eligible only if doc_recall@50 == 89/89, matching dense's ceiling exactly. Gate 2 (eligible candidates only) - compare doc_mrr > doc_ndcg@10 > doc_recall@10 against dense (Recall@50 is at ceiling for both and cannot distinguish an improvement). Practical tie: Recall@10 hit delta <= 1 out of 89 AND paired MRR/nDCG@10 95% bootstrap CIs both include 0 -> prefer dense-only (simpler, no second retrieval path). A hybrid win on one ranking metric with a credible (95% CI entirely below 0) regression on another is flagged for a user decision, never auto-resolved. A negative result (dense-only remains selected) is a fully valid Task 3.5 outcome.
